cs.t: Now that the weather is nice I got a helinox chair and a small goal zero yeti and with my a wifi hotspot I can go work in the park outdoors or on a patio all day. It's heavenly. I also love my bluetooth headphones with Noise Cancellation.  I can be in my own world at the gym, at work, at the coffeeshop.
